name: orf-to-protein-params
title: ORF finding → protein biophysical parameters
description: Curated workflow: find open reading frames in a DNA sequence, then compute biophysical parameters (MW, pI, GRAVY, instability) of the protein translated from the longest ORF. Demonstrates prior-step dot-path binding (orfs.0.protein). Chains two real, CI-gated tools; no fabrication.

params.dna: DNA sequence to scan for ORFs (required).
params.minAA: Minimum ORF length in amino acids (optional).
